pretreatments.description: Thermal-pretreatment conducted at 30 min at 50 °C using a water bath (CW-10G, Jeio Tech); at 80 °C with a water bath; at 120 °C using an autoclave (HAC-045, LK LabKorea).
Ultrasonic-pretreatment conducted for 30, 90, and 180 seconds on an ultrasonicator (VCX-130, Vibra-Cell) of 130 W.
Alkali-pretreatment adjusted to pH 9, 11, and 13 using 5 N NaOH.
Pre-treatment during substrate sample preparation involving sedimentation and centrifugation (5 min, 3000 rpm) of harvested microalgae biomass to separate solid and liquid phases.

Pretreatment involving pH adjustment of the initial mixture to pH 10.2 (likely due to mixing conditions) before the BMP test, though this is not explicitly termed a 'pretreatment' method in the text, it affects the substrate properties.
